caption: Beets and honey are some of the healthiest ingredients you can gift to your body #usahealth #wellness #healthybodyhealthymind #chinesemedicineworks #wellnessjourney
transcript: Ferment beets in raw honey, and watch what happens. Western doctors stay silent about this. There is no profit in something so simple. Dice two raw beets into small cubes and place them in a clean glass jar. Pour in half a cup of raw unpasteurized honey. Then add water until the beets are fully covered. Seal loosely. Let it rest in a cool dark place for seven days. The honey will turn deep ruby red and bubbles will form. That is how you know it is alive. In the ancient teachings, beets are among the most powerful circulation boosters on Earth. Fermented in raw honey, they become a Tibetan tonic used for over 2,000 years. One spoonful a day supports blood flow, healthy pressure, the liver, digestion, and natural energy. My book, Time to Heal, holds this remedy and many more. Begin your healing today. It waits for you in my profile.
